title: Higurashi WHEN THEY CRY: Cotton Drifting Arc
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The second arc of the Higurashi mystery-horror adaptation. Newcomer Keiichi Maebara, living in the rural village of Hinamizawa, meets Shion, the identical twin of his friend Mion, as the Cotton Drifting festival nears; the village has a history of grisly murders on festival night, linked to the curse of the local deity Oyashiro-sama, and some of his friends are tied to that history.
life_message: No life ideal is held up; the arc shows how suspicion, secrets and family pressure turn friends into victims (to verify).

content.note: Grisly festival-night murders; art 'occasionally shocking' (Manga Bookshelf; MU Murder/s, Death; Yen Press Older Teen rating).
